name: The University of Akron

athletics.revShareNotes: MAC had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). School-level payout not public; MAC schools pay a small fraction of the $20.5M cap and most departments already run on large institutional/student-fee subsidies (Hustle Belt).

ratingNotes: FB: among FBS's worst records since 2018; Joe Moorhead since 2022. MBB: John Groce's Zips are the MAC's most consistent program (MAC tournament titles and NCAA bids in 2024 and 2025). Olympic: 2010 NCAA men's soccer champion.
notes: University-wide budget crises (2020 layoffs, later deficits) keep the football subsidy and low attendance under scrutiny, making Akron a candidate in any "drop to FCS" storyline. Plays Kent State for the Wagon Wheel. Exposed to Ohio state politics (SB 1 higher-ed law of 2025, state funding).

name: Eastern Michigan University

athletics.revShareNotes: MAC had 100% opt-in for 2025-26 (Sportico). School-level payout not public; MAC schools pay a small fraction of the $20.5M cap and most departments already run on large institutional/student-fee subsidies (Hustle Belt). EMU has one of the highest subsidy shares in FBS.

ratingNotes: FB: Chris Creighton made EMU respectable, with bowls in 2016, 2018 and 2021-23, including the 2022 Famous Idaho Potato Bowl, its first bowl win since 1987. Attendance is among the lowest in FBS. MBB: Stan Heath. Olympic: historic men's swimming and track programs.
notes: The MAC school most often told it "should drop to FCS" because of its student-fee and general-fund subsidy and tiny crowds. Cut four sports in 2018 (including wrestling, men's swimming and diving, softball and women's tennis), which drew a Title IX lawsuit. Alumni-founded GameAbove gave a major gift (2022) and naming rights. The Detroit market is dominated by Michigan and Michigan State.

name: California State University, Sacramento

athletics.revShareNotes: Was in the Big Sky (FCS) for 2025-26; the Big Sky was not among the 100%-opt-in leagues and Sac State's choice was not verified. MAC entry: $18M MAC entry fee plus $5M NCAA FBS reclassification fee.

ratingNotes: FB: Troy Taylor's 2021-22 Big Sky champions; Andy Thompson coached 2023-24; Brennan Marion (from UNLV) since 2025. 2026 is the first MAC/FBS season, and the team cannot win the MAC title or play in a bowl for its first two seasons. MBB: Mike Bibby hired in 2025, with Shaquille O'Neal attached to the program. Moved to the Big West for non-football sports in 2026-27. Facilities: the small on-campus arena and an aging stadium are a weakness, with new-stadium plans pending.
notes: FOOTBALL-ONLY MAC affiliate: a 5-year term from 2026-07-01 that fills NIU's football slot and keeps the MAC at 13 football teams. President Luke Wood leads an aggressive FBS push backed by donors, the Sacramento business and political community, and Shaq. The Pac-12 passed on Sac State (2025), and the NCAA Football Oversight Committee recommended against its FBS waiver before the MAC deal. Non-football sports joined the Big West on 2026-07-01, effectively replacing UC Davis (to the Mountain West). Women's rowing joins the MAC as an affiliate for the 2027 season. Risks: CSU system budget cuts, California politics, a West Coast travel burden for MAC opponents, and an unbuilt stadium. The Causeway Classic with UC Davis becomes non-conference.
